notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and Possessed Skaab.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
